propositions: Rebar's current deterministic output repair, schema extraction, three-attempt ceiling, and stop-reason fast-fail behavior must be preserved when migrating from bespoke orchestration to Pydantic AI seams.
Successful output retries must report aggregate operation-wide usage (requests and token counts from all attempts) in a single durable JSONL row, not accepted-attempt-only counts.

When retry exhaustion raises Pydantic UnexpectedModelBehavior, the implementation must walk the cause chain and re-raise only the exact Rebar-owned StructuredOutputError found there, never blanket-translating the upstream exception.

Failed ModelResponse objects must be sent complete on retry only when deterministic context window fit is provably satisfied; otherwise omitted whole without prefix truncation, while authoritative input, accepted output, and stored history remain complete.

Fallback and native-to-prompted candidate attempts do not enter UsageLimits or core usage billing; operational observability is provided via public model instrumentation trace/journal events with ordering, identity, and outcome, not synthesized token usage.
